name: Family Care Hub
_comment_icons: The -v2 suffix is load-bearing. Chrome decides whether an installed WebAPK needs a new icon by diffing this manifest, and it compares icon URLs, not image bytes -- artwork overwritten at the same path is invisible to it and the home-screen icon stays stale forever. iOS is worse: it snapshots the icon at add-to-home-screen time and never re-checks. So when the artwork changes, bump every icon to -v3 (here and in index.html) and rename the files; do not overwrite them in place. favicon.ico is deliberately absent from this list: a multi-size .ico is not a usable install icon and Chrome ignores it for WebAPK generation, so listing it only adds a candidate that other surfaces might pick. index.html still links it for browser tabs.
